column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE CIVIL PROCEDURE CODE (CHAPTER 101)

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :-

column2: This Act may be cited as the Civil Procedure Code
Section 5 of the Civil Procedure Code (Chapter 101)

column1: (hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby

column2: by  the  insertion,  immediately  after  the  definition
of  the  expression  “court”,  of  the  following
definition:–
“ “court  expert”  shall  mean  a  person  specially
skilled or knowledgeable in any subject, field
or  disciplines”;
by the insertion, immediately after the  definition
of the expression “legal document”, of the following
new  definition:–
“ “local authority” means any Municipal Council,
Urban  Council  or  Pradeshiya  Sabha  and

includes 
any  Authority 
created 
and
established by or under any law to exercise,
perform  and  discharge  powers,  duties  and
functions corresponding to or similar to the
powers,  duties  and  functions  exercised,
performed  and  discharged  by  any  such
Council or Sabha;”;
